sentences.text:
THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S 439 CR.PC (FILED U/S 483 BNSS) PRAYING TO RELEASE THE ABOVE NAMED PETITIONER ON REGULAR BAIL IN SPL.C.C.NO.656/2024 ORIGINATED FROM CR.NO.132/2024 OF THE RESPONDENT TUMAKURU WOMEN POLICE FOR THE OFFENCES PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTIONS 370, 376, 506 R/W 34 OF INDIAN PENAL CODE,
SECTION 6 AND 17 OF POCSO ACT, 2012, WHICH IS PENDING BEFORE THE HON'BLE ADDITIONAL DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE (FTSC-I), AT TUMAKURU.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE MOHAMMAD NAWAZ  ORAL ORDER

Learned counsel for petitioner after arguing for sometime has sought permission of the Court to withdraw the petition with liberty to file a fresh petition before the Sessions Court, in view of filing of charge sheet.
He is in judicial custody since then.
He had approached the Sessions Court seeking bail during crime stage.
Since the charge sheet is now filed, petitioner can be given an opportunity to file a petition before the Sessions Court seeking bail.
If any such petition is filed, the learned NC: 2025:KHC:987 Sessions Judge shall consider the same in accordance with law and dispose it as expeditiously as possible.

Sd/-
(MOHAMMAD NAWAZ) JUDGE HB/-
